scope: 43 objects discovered after five-agent-panel-2026-08-19, plus 7 governed objects that no longer exist in BigQuery.
method: Live schema read, date coverage, grain uniqueness, per-column population, sign checks, and byte/partition cost review. Evidence captured with tools_profile_candidate.py.

rham_ga_new_imei_mtd.reason: Aggregate new-device gross-add mix at site grain. Grain dt_id+brand+site_id is unique (211719/211719), all metrics fully populated, no negative values, 9 monthly cutoffs from 2026-01-08 to 2026-09-08.
rham_ga_new_imei_mtd.evidence: grain 211719 rows = 211719 distinct keys; ga_all min 1 max 11933; 0 nulls across GA columns.

rham_ga_new_imei_mth.reason: Closed-month counterpart of the new-device GA mix. Grain unique (256983/256983), metrics fully populated, no negatives.
rham_ga_new_imei_mth.evidence: grain 256983 rows = 256983 distinct keys; 9 periods 2026-01-31 to 2026-09-08.

rham_outlet_ga_quality.reason: Daily-dated outlet acquisition quality with channel and device detail. Base source for channel-level drilldown.

rham_outlet_ga_quality_dtu.reason: Adds sp_source DTU/NON-DTU and outlet_mapping_status, so one table answers both populations plus the comparison. Preferred over the ex_dtu filtered copies.

rham_outlet_ga_quality_mtd.reason: Cutoff-aligned MTD outlet acquisition quality. Grain month_id+brand+outlet_id unique (1162553/1162553), cutoff_dd is a constant 14 so current and prior months are directly comparable.
rham_outlet_ga_quality_mtd.evidence: grain 1162553 = 1162553 distinct; cutoff_dd min 14 max 14; 9 periods.

rham_outlet_ga_quality_mth.reason: Closed-month outlet acquisition quality. Grain unique (1786237/1786237), ga_days up to 31 confirming full-month coverage.

rham_outlet_ga_quality_ex_dtu.reason: NON-DTU-only filtered copy. The DTU table carries the same rows plus sp_source, so keeping both invites a silently wrong population in the answer.
rham_outlet_ga_quality_ex_dtu.evidence: 5913776 rows versus 6098772 in the unfiltered base.

rham_outlet_ga_quality_mth_ex_dtu.reason: Monthly NON-DTU-only filtered copy, same duplication risk.
rham_outlet_ga_quality_mth_ex_dtu.evidence: 1751629 rows versus 1786237 in the unfiltered monthly table.

rham_outlet_low_stock.reason: Only source for outlet stock availability. Grain dt_id+brand+outlet_id+kpi is unique within one partition (810193/810193).
rham_outlet_low_stock.evidence: grain verified on MAX(dt_id); 35.25 GB so a literal dt_id filter is mandatory.

rham_outlet_secondary_daily.reason: Daily secondary-sales value and transaction detail by outlet and price point.

rham_outlet_secondary_mtd.reason: Cutoff-aligned MTD secondary sales. NOT unique on month_id+brand+outlet_id+main_price (1163942 rows versus 1150707 distinct), so every query must aggregate rather than assume one row per outlet.
rham_outlet_secondary_mtd.evidence: grain 1163942 rows = 1150707 distinct keys; still 1153453 distinct after adding site_id.

rham_outlet_secondary_mth.reason: Closed-month secondary sales for trend and ranking.

rham_postpaid_ga_daily.reason: Postpaid gross adds and acquisition revenue with no employee identifier. Unique on the full dimension set (13925/13925 over the last 7 days).

rham_postpaid_ga_daily_direct_sales.reason: Carries id_sales and sales_name. Individual employee performance is not available to general chat.

rham_postpaid_ga_daily_gerai.reason: Carries nik_sales and employee name. Individual employee performance is not available to general chat.

rham_postpaid_ga_daily_direct_sales_trad.reason: Only 31 rows. Coverage looks like a pilot, so promoting it would let the agent answer a national question from a near-empty table.

rham_postpaid_ga_daily_partner_store.reason: Partner-store split whose overlap with rham_postpaid_ga_daily is not yet reconciled. Double counting risk until the relationship is proven.
rham_postpaid_ga_daily_partner_store.evidence: 937845 rows versus 1508403 in the base table.

rham_report_fb_device_5g.reason: 5G-device market share versus Telkomsel and XLS across five location levels. Grain dt_id+location_type+location unique (15539/15539).
rham_report_fb_device_5g.evidence: ms_* are fractions in 0-1 (ms_ioh max 0.745); ga_amount_* only 12210/15539 populated.

rham_report_fb_network_5g.reason: Market share among subscribers actually using the 5G network. Grain unique (12711/12711). Distinct population from the device table.

rham_site_ga_quality_daily.reason: Site-level acquisition quality with device and survival metrics at daily grain.

rham_site_ga_quality_mtd.reason: Cutoff-aligned MTD site acquisition quality. Grain month_id+site_id+brand unique (52078/52078) and every one of the 41 numeric columns is populated.

rham_site_ga_quality_mth.reason: Closed-month site acquisition quality. Grain unique (52078/52078), no empty numeric columns.

rham_site_traffic_usage_mtd.reason: MTD traffic and revenue by site and commercial segment, with LMTD comparison, run rate, and full-month projection already computed.
rham_site_traffic_usage_mtd.evidence: 2.27 GB partitioned as_of_date; carries traffic_mb_mtd, traffic_mb_lmtd, traffic_projected_full_month.

rham_site_traffic_usage_mth.reason: Closed-month traffic, revenue, quota utilisation, and burning behaviour by site and segment.
rham_site_traffic_usage_mth.evidence: 334M rows, 56.8 GB, partitioned month_id which is a DATE (2026-07-01), not a YYYYMM string.

rham_kec_wise_tnr.reason: 17.7 GB daily cube whose period semantics mix daily, rolling-30-day, and MTD columns in one row. The MTD and MTH siblings cover the reporting need at a fraction of the cost and risk.

rham_kec_wise_tnr_mtd.reason: Kecamatan, brand, and tenure KPI cube. Grain is unique per month (103297/103297). 68 of 184 numeric columns are entirely empty, so the empty list is recorded as warning_columns to stop the SQL writer ranking on nothing.
rham_kec_wise_tnr_mtd.evidence: dt_id is a within-month cutoff, not a daily series: MAX(dt_id)=2026-09-15 holds 103026 of 103297 rows for 202609.

rham_kec_wise_tnr_mth.reason: Closed-month counterpart. Grain unique per month (103446/103446) with 18 entirely empty numeric columns recorded as warning_columns.
rham_kec_wise_tnr_mth.evidence: empty_cols has 18 entries, all site-allocated voice/SMS revenue splits.

rham_kec_wise_tnr_kpi_ref.reason: A single undocumented column. It cannot explain a KPI code, so it adds no retrieval value yet.

rham_ftth_tt_mttr.reason: Only aggregate FTTH restoration-time source. Small and safe, but it mixes WEEKLY and MONTHLY rows and contains a 'Grand Total' bucket, both of which double count unless filtered.
rham_ftth_tt_mttr.evidence: period_type MONTHLY 142 rows (202601-202608) and WEEKLY 612 rows (2026W01-2026W36); bucket 'Grand Total' present 130 times; source_scope is VENDOR only.

rham_ftth_tt_mo_detail.reason: Mass-outage incident detail with free-text RCA, vendor, and infrastructure identifiers. Needs a reviewed aggregate contract before chat exposure.

rham_ftth_tt_mo_impacted.reason: Per-customer outage impact rows carrying customer_id, homepass_id, order_id, and ONT serial. Customer-grain data is not available to general chat.
rham_ftth_tt_mo_impacted.evidence: 6.7M rows, 2.4 GB, customer and ONT identifiers.

rham_ftth_tt_single_detail.reason: Individual trouble tickets with customer identifiers, agent names, and free-text cause fields.
rham_ftth_tt_single_detail.evidence: 61 columns, 790 MB, customer_id plus agent name.

rham_ga_quality_tracker.reason: Subscriber-grain cohort tracker keyed by msisdn with M0-M3 revenue and traffic history. Aggregate GA quality is already served by the site and outlet tables.

rham_ref_msisdn_dtu.reason: Subscriber identifier reference. Usable only inside controlled ETL, never in an agent-visible query.

rham_ref_msisdn_dtu_check.reason: Links an MSISDN to acquisition, revenue, traffic, and recharge behaviour. Highest privacy exposure in this review.

rham_ref_msisdn_dtu_bak20260912.reason: Dated backup of a subscriber reference. Stale, duplicated, and identifier bearing.
rham_ref_msisdn_dtu_bak20260912.evidence: name carries a bak20260912 suffix; 228859 rows versus 363659 in the live reference.

_stg_ref_msisdn_dtu.reason: Staging table of raw subscriber identifiers with no reviewed transformation owner.

rham_network_ncp.reason: Zero rows. The NCA and NCP formulas behind the 110 and 115 suffixes are also undocumented.

rham_network_ncp_stg.reason: Load staging table with one validation row. A staging object must never serve a runtime question.

rham_site_competitor.reason: Zero rows. Competitor metric definitions and provenance are also unverified.

rham_site_competitor_stg.reason: Staging table with two test rows.

rham_migration_matrix_monthly.reason: Successor shape of the deleted rham_subs_traffic_agg_migration_matrix_monthly, but it holds a single month and month_id is a DATE rather than the YYYYMM string used elsewhere. Promote once a second month lands and the period type is reconciled.

rham_site_wise_daily_snap_20260828.reason: Dated 60.6 GB snapshot kept for reproducibility. The maintained daily table answers the same questions without the frozen cutoff.
rham_site_wise_daily_snap_20260828.evidence: SNAPSHOT object type, 104M rows, name pins it to 2026-08-28.

rham_subs_traffic_agg_geo_mtd_lmtd.reason: Deleted from BigQuery. It was still in the runtime KB, so the agent was being shown the schema of a table that no longer exists.
rham_subs_traffic_agg_geo_mtd_lmtd.evidence: absent from list_tables; no rham_subs_traffic_* object remains in the dataset.

rham_subs_traffic_agg_migration_matrix_m.reason: Deleted from BigQuery and replaced by rham_migration_matrix_monthly, which is still a candidate pending a second month of data.

rham_subs_traffic_agg_segment_mtd_lmtd.reason: Deleted from BigQuery. Segment-level MTD versus LMTD traffic and revenue is now served by rham_site_traffic_usage_mtd.

rham_subs_traffic_dim_subs_segment_month.reason: Deleted from BigQuery. The blocked decision is retained so the name can never be reintroduced without a fresh review.
rham_subs_traffic_dim_subs_segment_month.evidence: absent from list_tables; previously quarantined as subscriber grain.

rham_subs_traffic_fact_subs_mtd_lmtd.reason: Deleted from BigQuery. Blocked decision retained.
rham_subs_traffic_fact_subs_mtd_lmtd.evidence: absent from list_tables; previously quarantined as subscriber grain.

rham_subs_traffic_raw_purchase_txn.reason: Deleted from BigQuery. Blocked decision retained.
rham_subs_traffic_raw_purchase_txn.evidence: absent from list_tables; previously quarantined as raw customer transactions.

rham_subs_traffic_raw_subs_daily.reason: Deleted from BigQuery. Blocked decision retained.
rham_subs_traffic_raw_subs_daily.evidence: absent from list_tables; previously quarantined as raw customer data.
